title: Tart Cherry Limeade
description: This tart cherry limeade recipe is simply made with frozen limeade concentrate, lemon-lime soda, fresh lime juice, and maraschino cherry juice.
ingredients: 2 (12 fluid ounce) cans frozen limeade concentrate
1 (2 liter) bottle lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage
1 (10 ounce) jar maraschino cherries, drained and juice reserved

steps.text: Pour 2 cans limeade concentrate into a large pitcher; stir in lemon-lime soda, reserved cherry juice, and lime juice. Stir well; serve over ice. Garnish servings with cherries and lime slices.

video.description: See how to make wonderfully tart cherry limeade from scratch.
